# openai_tenant_workload_identity_federation_rule (Resource)

Beta. Map an external identity to an existing principal in a ChatGPT workspace or to an existing project service account in an API organization. Exactly one destination is required. Destinations must already be linked to the tenant. A tenant identity provider currently supports one API organization and multiple ChatGPT workspaces. Terraform needs tenant.workload_identity.read and tenant.workload_identity.write to manage this resource.

Authentication: Set the tenant_admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_TENANT_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the tenant API audience; with a custom tenant_base_url, set the tenant_admin_api_key provider attribute explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_tenant_workload_identity_federation_rule" "example" {
  workload_identity_provider_id = "workload_identity_provider_123"
  workspace_target              = { workspace_id = "workspace_123", principal_id = "user_123", external_subject = "repo:example/codex-ci:environment:production", audiences = ["https://openai.example.com/codex-ci"] }
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openai_tenant_workload_identity_federation_rule.example
  id = "workload_identity_provider_123/workload_identity_federation_rule_123"
}
```
